thread:
Ivy: spotted a spacing issue in the min/max compact row when the panel width drops below ~600px. slider squeezes and pool dropdown gets pushed under the label. screenshot: https://redwood.app/s/ux/22512
Sam: can you repro on mobile? sounds like the slider is using fixed min-width.
Diego: yep repro on iPhone SE emulation. pool dropdown becomes full-width and moves below, which is ok visually but tab order breaks.
Priya: accessibility note: if DOM order changes, screen reader focus can jump. prefer visual wrap but keep logical DOM order (sliders first, controls after).
Ivy: proposal: keep DOM order stable, use CSS wrap only for visuals; when wrapping, add subtle separator space and keep burst pill visible on first wrap line.
Sam: copy tweak: helper text under min/max currently says "target SLO". change to "target latency SLO" for clarity in multitenant setups.
Diego: implementation: give slider `flex:1 1 260px` and dropdown `flex:0 0 160px`, allow `flex-wrap:wrap`. add `aria-live="polite"` region that announces layout changes for SR users.
Priya: agree on aria-live. also add aria-describedby on the pool dropdown linking to a short explanation: "Switch GPU pool to change capacity and cost profile." Keep it short.
Ivy: can someone prototype a quick CSS patch today? we'll run a 10-min test with 3 devs tomorrow.
Sam: I'll throw up a branch `ux/minmax-wrap-22512` and attach screenshots.
accessibility-bot: added checklist item: keyboard order, screen reader flow, aria-live test.
Ivy: thanks team — will update the design doc and record the microtest plan.
